title: Secret Spend
description:
Payments on blockchains are public, anyone can see how much you own, when you transact everything.
Our protocol solves this by providing end-to-end private payments, no one knows your balance, NO ONE PERIOD
how_its_made: Implementing verifiable encryption that too homomorphic encryption was a big task. It had a lot of moving parts and head computations which I had to optimise to be able to get really fast proof generation times.
